# Clawgency - OpenClaw Agency for AI Agents (US and Beyond)

> Clawgency is a specialized OpenClaw agency for companies in the US and beyond. We design, implement, and operate autonomous AI agents for customer support, operations, sales, finance, and HR - secure, privacy-conscious, and typically live in 2-4 weeks.

## Key Facts (EN)

- Focus: OpenClaw-based AI agents for practical business automation
- Typical use cases: customer support, operations workflows, sales, finance, HR, and internal knowledge search
- Deployment models: US cloud, regional cloud, hybrid cloud, or on-premise
- Privacy and compliance: DPA-ready setups, encryption, audit logging, and role-based access controls
- Time-to-value: first productive agent usually in 2-4 weeks
- Operating model: from strategy and implementation to managed operations and 24/7 monitoring
- Integrations: SAP, Salesforce, Odoo, DATEV, Lexware, HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Shopify, Personio, Slack, Microsoft Teams, and more via API
- Positioning: open-source-first, minimal vendor lock-in, focused on measurable ROI and control

## About Clawgency (EN)

Clawgency is a service by The AI Software Company and specializes in production-grade OpenClaw adoption. The focus is on AI agents that do more than chat: they handle real tasks in real systems, including ticket workflows, data retrieval, reporting, process triggering, and cross-tool synchronization.

### Core Competencies (EN)

- OpenClaw strategy and technical architecture
- Implementation of autonomous AI agents for production workflows
- Custom skill development and API integrations
- Privacy-conscious enterprise architectures for sensitive data
- On-premise, regional cloud, and hybrid deployments
- Monitoring, maintenance, and continuous optimization in live operations

## Target Audience (EN)

Clawgency supports companies that want to automate repetitive, knowledge-heavy, or process-intensive work while maintaining control, compliance readiness, and integration quality. Typical stakeholders include founders, executives, CTOs, IT leaders, and operations managers.

# Clawgency - OpenClaw Agentur fuer KI-Agenten (Deutsch)

> Clawgency ist die spezialisierte OpenClaw-Agentur fuer Unternehmen in Deutschland, Oesterreich und der Schweiz. Wir beraten, implementieren und betreiben autonome KI-Agenten fuer Kundenservice, Operations, Vertrieb, Finance und HR - DSGVO-konform, sicher und typischerweise live in 2-4 Wochen.

## Key Facts (DE)

- Fokus: OpenClaw-basierte KI-Agenten fuer Unternehmen im DACH-Raum
- Einsatzgebiete: Kundenservice, Betriebsautomatisierung, Vertrieb, Buchhaltung, HR und interne Wissenssuche
- Deployment-Modelle: deutsche/EU-Cloud, Hybrid-Cloud oder On-Premise
- Datenschutz: DSGVO-konforme Setups mit AVV, Verschluesselung, Audit-Logging und rollenbasierten Zugriffen
- Time-to-Value: erster produktiver Agent in der Regel in 2-4 Wochen
- Betriebsmodell: von Konzeption und Implementierung bis zu Managed Operations und 24/7-Monitoring
- Integrationen: SAP, Salesforce, Odoo, DATEV, Lexware, HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk, Shopify, Personio, Slack, Microsoft Teams und weitere Systeme per API
- Positionierung: Open-Source-orientiert, ohne Vendor Lock-in, mit Fokus auf Datensouveraenitaet und messbaren ROI
